SVRTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 930 PM MST.

* At 831 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 14 miles southeast
of Willcox, moving southwest at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Willcox, Chiricahua National Monument, Pearce-Sunsites, Cochise,
Sunizona, Kansas Settlement and Rucker Canyon.

This includes the following highways...
Route 181 between mile markers 39 and 64. Route 191 between mile
markers 37 and 66. Interstate 10 between mile markers 325 and 339.
Route 186 between mile markers 328 and 359.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 830 PM MST, the public reported thunderstorms producing heavy rain
across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen.
Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Public reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Safford, Thatcher, Solomon, San Jose, Roper Lake State Park,
Safford Regional Airport, Pima, Central, Frye Mesa Dam and Swift
Trail Junction.

This includes the following highways...
Route 191 between mile markers 108 and 120. Route 70 between mile
markers 310 and 348.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Tidwell Wash, San Simon River, Gibson Creek, Noon Creek, Marijilda
Wash, Peck Wash, Coyote Wash, Lone Star Wash, Gila River, Ash
Creek, Watson Wash, Bigler Wash, Black Rock Wash, Stockton Wash,
Twilight Creek, Markham Wash, Frye Creek, Slick Rock Wash,
Patterson Wash, Jacobson Creek and Hot Springs Wash.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
A line of strong thunderstorms will move southwest to west at near 15
knots across the nearshore and offshore waters adjacent to the Upper
Keys including Florida Bay, and eastern portions of Hawk Channel and
the Florida Straits. The strongest activity will produce gusty and
erratic winds of 25 to 30 knots, frequent lightning strikes, and
blinding downpours.

events.summary:
* IMPACTS: Low humidities, hot temperatures, gusty winds, and a
wind shift with a cold front will create erratic fire behavior.

* AFFECTED AREA:
In Southeast MT Fire Zone...132.
In Southeast MT and Northwest SD Fire Zone...133.

* COUNTIES AFFECTED:
In Northwest SD...Harding.
In Southeast MT...Carter...Custer...Fallon.

evening shifting winds out of the northwest and increasing wind
speeds.

* WIND: Northwest 10 to 20 mph with gusts up to 30 mph.

* HUMIDITY: As low as 10 percent.

* TEMPERATURES: Up to 95 degrees.

events.summary:
...The National Weather Service in Kansas City/Pleasant Hill has
issued a Flood Warning for the following rivers in Missouri...

Big Creek at Blairstown affecting Henry, Cass and Johnson Counties.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Big Creek at Blairstown.

* WHEN...From Thursday morning to Saturday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 20.0 feet, The west bank of the creek begins to flood.
At 23.0 feet, Flooding occurs at the west approach to the N Highway
bridge located 0.2 miles west of Blairstown. Flooding also occurs
across B Highway near Big Creek which is several miles northwest of
Blairstown.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:00 PM CDT Wednesday the stage was 11.6 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage
tomorrow morning to a crest of 21.9 feet tomorrow evening. It
will then fall below flood stage early Friday afternoon.
- Flood stage is 20.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
